release_notes:
1. Streamlined Left-Sidebar Panel Navigation: Replaced top horizontal tabs with a dedicated vertical sidebar panel on the left (GTM & DataLayer, Platform Routing, Server-Side & Webhooks, Custom Scripts).
2. Decluttered Interface: Removed extraneous Overview, Events Catalog, Data Mapping, and Diagnostics & Testing views as requested, focusing strictly on functional configuration.
3. Dedicated Panel Save Controls: Each configuration panel includes its own direct save action alongside the global floating unsaved changes banner.
4. Preserved 100% Tracking Integrity: Zero DOM scraping, backend data models, authoritative catalog matching, and sGTM webhooks fully preserved.
